name: Gaussian Conditional Probability Formulation
definition: Treats the unnormalized 4D Gaussian as a special probability distribution over spatial coordinates $(u, v)$ and time $t$, enabling factorization into temporal and conditional spatial components.
summary: Gaussian Conditional Probability Formulation decomposes 3D Gaussians into marginal and conditional distributions for efficient slice-based rendering, avoiding full 3D density processing.
